room_rent.note: Rateable proportion applies to associated medical expenses if higher room taken. Optional add-on (Removal of Room Rent Limit) upgrades to Single Private AC Room.

icu.note: Rateable proportion clause does not apply to ICU stays.

copayment.display: None (base); Zone co-pay up to 20% for out-of-zone treatment
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Zone II policyholders bear 10% for Zone I treatment; Zone III bear 10% for Zone II and 20% for Zone I. Optional voluntary co-pay of 10% or 20% available only under ProHealth Select (A). Co-pay and deductible cannot be combined.

sub_limits.display: No sub-limits (base); optional Disease Specific Sub-limits available under Select (A)
sub_limits.note: Base plan has no disease sub-limits. Optional Disease Specific Sub-limit cover (Select A only) caps: Cataract ₹7.5K–₹22.5K/eye, Hernia ₹12.5K–₹37.5K, Joint Replacement ₹40K–₹80K, Cardiac ₹40K–₹80K, Cancer ₹40K–₹80K, and others.

deductible.note: Deductible is an optional cover (₹1/2/3/4/5 Lacs); aggregate per policy year. Cannot be combined with voluntary co-pay.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reduced to extent of prior coverage under portability/migration.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, knee replacement, varicose veins, calculus diseases, BPH, piles/fissures/fistula, ENT disorders, hysterectomy, joint replacement, spondylitis, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl 18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned in this policy.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (5%/yr, no reduction on claim)
cumulative_bonus.note: 5% per year, max 100% of SI. Not reduced for claims. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster upgrades to 10%/25%/50% per year up to 100%, or 10%/yr up to 200%.

restoration.note: Restored SI available once per policy year only for unrelated illness/injury. Not available for ₹0.5L and ₹1L SI under Select (A). Restored SI not carried forward and not counted for cumulative bonus.

pre_hosp.note: Covered on reimbursement basis for same condition as hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Covered on reimbursement basis for same condition as hospitalisation.

day_care.display: 171 listed procedures, up to full SI
day_care.note: Specific list of 171 day care procedures in Annexure II. OPD treatment not covered.

domiciliary.note: Requires treatment for at least 3 days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, COPD, arthritis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, and several other conditions for domiciliary claims.

ayush.note: In-patient/day care in AYUSH hospital or AYUSH Day Care Centre. Excludes pleasure/rejuvenation treatments and treatment outside India.

organ_donor.note: Covers in-patient hospitalisation expenses for organ harvesting from donor. Excludes pre/post-hospitalisation for donor, donor screening costs, organ acquisition costs.

ambulance.note: Covers road ambulance by registered healthcare/ambulance provider for emergency. Also covers inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments (robotic/HIFU/stereotactic/oral chemo/immunotherapy/intravitreal injections/stem cell therapy etc.) covered under in-patient or day care.

consumables.note: Base policy excludes consumables (Annexure IV List I). Optional Health 360 Shield add-on covers listed non-medical items up to base SI and durable medical equipment up to ₹1L.

global_cover.display: Optional (Worldwide Emergency Cover, Select A only)
global_cover.note: Covers emergency in-patient hospitalisation outside India up to SI, reimbursement only in INR. Available only under ProHealth Select (A) as optional cover.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium payment. Coverage available during grace period if premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting. Refund within 7 days of cancellation request.

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, treatment outside India (base), sleep apnea devices, CPAP, femto-laser/multifocal lens cataract, non-allopathic (except AYUSH)

optional_riders.display: Deductible, Voluntary Co-pay (A only), Cumulative Bonus Booster, Room Rent Limit Removal, Re-Assurance, Health Check-up (A), Worldwide Emergency (A), Disease Sub-limits (A), HMB (A), CI Add-on, Health 360 (Shield/OPD)
